title: Chapter 81 Human Wanderer
content:
Chapter 81 Human Wanderer

The huge transport team of the evil god army is being destroyed at a terrifying speed!

When the Zerg troops killed the middle of the transport team, the giant lizards responsible for transportation here had rectangular boxes covered with black cloth on their backs.

The puppy rushed forward, swung his knife arm, and killed the giant lizards responsible for transportation in a few strokes. The giant lizards that died instantly turned into light and disappeared.

The puppy's knife arm lifted the black cloth on the box that fell heavily due to the disappearance of the giant lizard. Only then did he realize that it was not a box under the black cloth, but an iron cage.

There were many humanoid creatures in the cage. When the puppies saw the living creatures, they raised their knives to kill them, but suddenly they all stopped!

The nearby puppies lifted all the black cloth on the same iron cages. After a closer look, they found that they were all filled with tall and strong humans.

They were ragged, unkempt, and their hands and feet were shackled with special shackles. The whole cage exuded an unpleasant and strange smell.

These people are all human beings, not believers of the evil god. This is why the Queen of Worms, who has been paying attention to every detail on the battlefield, stopped the dogs in time.

The Queen of Worms is the collective consciousness of the Zerg, and Wu Qing's consciousness is also a part of this collective consciousness, and it is the master of this consciousness.

So, from another perspective, it is not a problem to say that the Queen of Worms is a special clone of Wu Qing with independent consciousness.

Many of the Queen of Worms' thoughts and ways of thinking have been greatly influenced by Wu Qing.

When encountering such a situation on the battlefield, Wu Qing will stop the dogs, and the Queen of Worms has the same idea.

After the Queen of Worms stopped the dogs, she let most of the dogs continue to perform combat missions, and she notified Wu Qing of the situation here.

Wu Qing is also paying attention to this war from the perspective of the Zerg, but he cannot do everything like the Queen of Worms for the time being. After receiving the Queen of Worms' notice, he immediately transferred part of his consciousness to the Zerg present.

So many human beings appeared in the transport team of the evil god camp and were tightly imprisoned. Wu Qing felt that these people's bodies should be unusual.

Observing closely, these humans are determined people. Facing the current situation, no one shows panic.

They either face it calmly, or close their eyes to rest, or look curiously. No one is afraid, and no one speaks.

The puppy possessed by Wu Qing cannot communicate with others. The Queen of Insects has sent a one-star hydralisk over.

The spiritual power of the one-star hydralisk is strong enough to communicate with others.

Wu Qing transferred his consciousness to the one-star hydralisk and passed the information to the human in front of him through spiritual power.

"Who are you?"

The human in the cage in front of the one-star hydralisk looked at it.

A bearded man said in a dry and hoarse voice: "Go find our leader!"

"Who is your leader?"

"Masked boss!"

The Queen of Insects instantly locked the only human with a black cloth on his face through the puppy's perspective.

The one-star hydralisk carrying Wu Qing's consciousness quickly ran towards the masked man.

"Are you their leader? Who are you?"

"Human wanderers."

The masked man was a sturdy man sitting cross-legged, and his body was cleaner than the others.

His voice was also very hoarse, and these humans must have not had water or food for a long time.

Wu Qing didn't know who the human wanderers were, but Meng was next to his insect clone, and Meng had a very broad knowledge.

The battle to destroy the transport team was still going on, and there was still some time to understand the situation.

"Meng, do you know the human wanderers?"

Wu Qing asked Meng beside him.

"Human wanderers? That's a group of extraordinary people!"

"They are a collective name for a group of human strongmen who have no ties. They freely form wanderer tribes of varying sizes and wander around!"

"They are strong and determined, and those believers in evil gods have to take a detour when they see them!"

"Why? Why are you suddenly interested in human wanderers?"

Meng really knows a little about human wanderers, and he gave Wu Qing a brief introduction.

"There are nearly 2,000 human wanderers imprisoned in the transport team just now!"

Wu Qing did not hide it from Meng.

"What?!"

"Then rescue them quickly!"

"If we can't rescue them, we can't leave them there even if we kill them all!"

When Meng heard Wu Qing say that there were nearly 2,000 living human wanderers in the transport team, he jumped up in a hurry.

"Don't worry, the human wanderers are now controlled by the Zerg, tell me the reason!"

Wu Qing comforted Meng on this side, and immediately ordered the puppy to open the iron cage on the other side.

"Human wanderers are rarely captured alive by the evil god camp!"

"Now that so many have been captured and transported here, the evil god's army camp must be holding a major sacrificial ceremony!"

"The evil god likes these determined people the most. If so many human wanderers are used to sacrifice to the evil god, the Tengu tribe will have no chance of winning if they get a response from the evil god!"

"Fortunately, the Zerg accidentally rescued these human wanderers this time, and the Tengu tribe can be said to have good luck!"

"With such an important sacrifice in the transport team, it's no wonder that so many elite bear goblin troops were sent to escort it!"

After hearing Wu Qing say that the human wanderers were controlled by the Zerg, Meng was relieved and explained the reason to Wu Qing.

Wu Qing knew that the quality of the soul and spiritual power of intelligent creatures with strong wills was not comparable to that of ordinary people. The evil gods who were good at using the energy of faith would certainly like it.

"Wu Qing, try your best to bring them out. If things can't be done, let them be freed!"

"They will be grateful to you too!"

Meng continued to say to Wu Qing.

"Don't worry! I have my own way to solve it!"

Wu Qing began to pay close attention to the situation on the battlefield.

After receiving Wu Qing's order, the Zerg puppy chopped open all the iron cages that imprisoned the human wanderers without saying a word.

The human wanderers, who were exactly two thousand in number, stood up, but the shackles on their hands and feet restricted their movements.

Feeling that the Zerg had no ill intentions, the masked leader of the human wanderers raised his hands in front of the puppy and stretched the handcuffs straight.

"Clang!"

A sound of metal and iron clashing sounded, and the puppy's knife arm chopped on the handcuffs, and the handcuffs did not move at all!

The Zerg puppy, which could easily cut through the interstellar space alloy, had trouble with this special handcuff after being weakened.

However, there is no material that the Zerg cannot handle. If the blade arm doesn't work, use the mouth!

The Zerg can secrete a super biodegradable liquid from its mouth, and few materials can withstand the decomposition and corrosion of this biodegradable liquid.

The puppy's terrifying mouth stretched out, and the masked leader's eyes did not fluctuate at all.

"Crack!"

The sharp teeth mixed with biodegradable liquid bit hard, and the extremely strong handcuffs broke with a sound.

With a solution, the puppies acted quickly, and with the cooperation of the human wanderers, they opened the shackles on their hands and feet.
